panels.title: Solves per second (right vs wrong)
panels.description: Solve outcomes over five-minute windows. A persistently high wrong share is usually one attacker hammering a challenge before giving up — each wrong answer burns the challenge.

panels.title: Redeem outcomes per second
panels.description: Verify endpoint results. new = first successful verification, replay = the one allowed same-token network retry, conflict = a different token tried to reuse a consumed proof (someone attacking), not_found = nothing left to redeem.

panels.title: 429 rate-limit rejections (5m window)
panels.description: Requests rejected by the per-IP token bucket. Sustained nonzero here is rate limiting doing its job; a spike from a single IP is a scraper about to be blocked.

panels.title: Redis errors (5m rate)
panels.description: Failed Redis operations while serving requests. Anything nonzero is a problem: the service degrades to fail-closed challenges / fail-open rate limits depending on path.

panels.title: Challenges awaiting expiry
panels.description: Size of the challenge:expiry sorted set — live challenges plus grace-window leftovers. Should stay small and flat; continuous growth means the sweeper is stuck or through-put jumped.
